scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Women And Girl Acid Attack Victims
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Haryana
Applicant must be a woman or girl
Applicant must have suffered disfigurement or become disabled due to acid attack or a similar corrosive substance
Acid attack must have occurred on or after 2nd May 2011
Applicant must have resided in Haryana for at least 3 years since the acid attack
Application may be made on the victim's behalf by parent(s), legal heir(s), guardian, or husband if married
benefits_summary: Financial assistance equal to 2.5×, 3.5×, or 4.5× the monthly Divyang Pension based on disability percentage.
